segment_summary: এই অভ্যন্তরীণ শক্তির উৎস কেবল বেঁচে থাকার তাগিদ নয়, বরং এক গভীর, অপ্রকাশিত সংকল্পের প্রতিধ্বনি।

segment_enrichment.angle: Treating inner resistance through material metaphor: The internal fire represented not by flame (as used elsewhere), but by polished, unyielding basalt or iron slag.
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: Standing motionless at the edge of the domestic space during a long, silent night; Desire: To feel a specific sound—a single distant bird call or water drop hitting stone—to break the oppressive auditory vacuum (Obstacle: Complete sonic isolation); Turn: The silence itself begins to generate its own resonant frequency.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Examining fatigue through the lens of time dilation—how moments stretch into unbearable eternities in her solitude.
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The tactile sensation of coarse jute against skin during sleepless vigil.
segment_enrichment.research_question: What specific archaic Bengali lexicon exists to describe sustained psychological siege without implying direct confrontation?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: Employing an AABB/CCDD rhyme scheme structure in some stanzas, disrupting the free verse rhythm to mirror forced internal order against external chaos.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: Unlike chapters focusing on external pressure or cosmic testing, this piece centers entirely on the *internal physics* of resilience—the sheer mechanics of continuing when all evidence suggests collapse is inevitable. It pivots from 'trial' to 'tenacity'.
